description: Funding radar over every Hyperliquid perp: 337 on 13 Oct 2026, 178 on the main dex and 159 on the HIP-3 dexes (stocks, indices, commodities, FX). Per perp: the current funding at its 8h equivalent, its 30-day z-score against its own settled history, the dex and asset class, and a flag on any |z| of 2 or more, most extreme first. By default it returns the perps with $10M and up of open interest; min_oi_usd changes that and 0 returns them all. Precomputed every 5 minutes with as_of; a snapshot older than 15 minutes answers 503 and is never billed. Costs 0.02 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

min_oi_usd.description: minimum open interest in USD: default 10000000 ($10M); 0 returns every perp the radar tracks

top.description: perps returned, most extreme first, 1-100, default 20
